R024.workload: Nine alternating-order pairs, each owner renders 30 prepared 1280x720 black/white limited-range I420 frames at native size; cold canvas/pipeline allocation and teardown included; final synchronized readback included for both. No sleeps or vsync throttling.
R024.baseline: Actual maintained YUVPresenter complete row packing/upload/draw
R024.candidate: Construct and close a raw I420 VideoFrame per frame, draw to Canvas2D
R024.correctness: Independent exact black/white oracle; compare full final image, changed frame, padded-stride prior gate and invalid-stride rejection before timing. No color/HDR generalization.
R024.value_gate: Paired saving lower bootstrap95 bound at least10%; nine independent owner pairs, 10000 bootstrap resamples seed2401.
R024.excluded: Source decoding and fixture generation identical and outside both prepared-plane presentation tasks; physical memory and energy not claimed.

R335.workload: Nine alternating-order pairs: predecode12-frame64x48 closedH264 GOP, draw heldlast frame; destroy GPUdevice; recover same output and decode next GOP on surviving or reopened decoder. Measure recovery through synchronized output and same final cleanup; record preloss setup separately.
R335.baseline: Recreate GPU owner and reset decoder, replay same12 packets to held target
R335.candidate: Recreate GPU owner, retain healthy decoder and held frame
R335.correctness: Held redraw identical; subsequentGOP pixels independent host hashes; stale old presenter generation rejected; corrupted expected hash differs; resources closed.
R335.metric: Recovery+postloss verification+cleanup wall milliseconds (includes replay where required)
R335.value_gate: Paired saving lower bootstrap95 bound at least10%; nine pairs, 10000 bootstrap resamples seed3351.
R335.excluded: Physical device removal, driver crashes and production renderer integration; no CPU/energy claim.
